capabilities: convert case of selected text (upper, lower, word, sentence)
encode and decode Base64 and URLs, and apply ROT13
replace, remove, or add spaces, dashes, and underscores
flatten comma-separated items into a list and back
reverse text or words and strip non-alphanumeric characters
disambiguation: Not file-format conversion; it rewrites selected characters in place (case, encodings, separators, list items).
extras: README is a bare feature list with small inline examples; it does not explain how conversions are invoked (commands vs other UI).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for quick character-level transformations of selected text such as case changes, Base64/URL encoding, or swapping separators.
summary: Text transformation tool that applies case changes, encodings, space swaps, and list conversions to the selected text via commands.
